description: This file defines a feature for deleting an article within a C# ASP.NET Core application. It contains a command record, validation logic, and an asynchronous handler that interacts with the database context to remove an article by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: A request object representing the command to delete an article, identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator class ensuring the command's Slug property is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article from the database based on the provided slug asynchronously.

methods.name: CommandValidator.constructor
methods.description: Sets up validation rules for the Command, ensuring Slug is not null or empty.

methods.name: QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion logic, retrieving the article by slug, removing it, saving changes, and handling not found errors.
